title: SBU detains former sailor in Odesa suspected of directing Russian attacks
summary: The Security Service of Ukraine's (SBU) military counterintelligence unit has detained a former merchant ship sailor in Odesa who is suspected of helping Russia direct its strikes.

title: Intelligence reveals details of Russian Gerbera-2 drone with range of up to 1,200 km
summary: The Ukrainian Defense Ministry's Main Intelligence Directorate (HUR) has released information about the components of the Russian Gerbera-type unmanned aerial vehicle.

title: Russian attack leaves 130 settlements without power in Zhytomyr region
summary: Russian forces attacked an energy facility in the Zhytomyr region overnight on November 3, leaving 130 settlements without electricity.

title: Russian attacks damage homes and power lines in Cherkasy, two people injured
summary: Two people were injured in a Russian drone strike on the city of Cherkasy.

title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 2,060 over past day
summary: Russia’s total combat losses since the start of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, have reached approximately 1,594,830 personnel as of November 3, 2026, including 2,060 troops killed or wounded over the past day.

title: Russian forces launch repeated strike on Dnipro, leaving people injured
summary: Russian forces launched another attack on Dnipro in the morning, damaging residential buildings and injuring civilians.

title: Ukraine intercepts 66% of Russia’s jet-powered Shahed drones in October – General Staff
summary: Ukraine’s Defense Forces destroyed 4,859 Shahed-type drones used by Russian forces to attack Ukraine during October.

title: Injury toll in Russian attack on Kharkiv rises to 62
summary: The number of people injured after a medical facility in Kharkiv’s Nemyshlianskyi district was hit has risen to 62, while more than 220 patients are being evacuated to other hospitals.

title: Putin panicking ahead of U.S. elections – Congressman Whitesides
summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin is panicking as he anticipates a change in the composition of the U.S. Congress and, together with President Donald Trump, is trying to force Ukraine into making unfavorable concessions before the newly elected Congress begins its session in January, Democratic Congressman George Whitesides believes.

title: Kharkiv hit by Russian attack, medical facility struck, casualties reported
summary: Russian forces launched a massive attack on Kharkiv with ballistic missiles and guided aerial bombs, with one of the strikes hitting a medical facility in the Nemyshlianskyi district, leaving people injured.

title: Up to four groups of power cuts scheduled across Ukraine on Tuesday – Ukrenergo
summary: Electricity consumption restrictions will be in effect in some regions of Ukraine on Tuesday, November 3, from 00:00 to 23:59.

title: Czech PM outlines army priorities for coming years
summary: The priorities for developing the Czech Armed Forces are increasing troop numbers and strengthening air defence.

title: Ukraine to establish center for return of civilian detainees
summary: Following the humanitarian mission to Oleshky, Ukraine will establish a separate Center for the Return of Civilian Citizens of Ukraine, which will operate under the Ombudsman's Office.

title: Odesa to receive 20 buses from Romania’s Galati for public transport during blackouts
summary: Odesa and the Romanian city of Galați are launching a partnership in the areas of municipal services, transportation, infrastructure restoration, culture, and education.
